Risk: AWS Academy lab session expires / is reset, wiping all resources
Mitigation: One-command redeploy (redeploy_all.py); keep all infra as code; export DynamoDB data before stopping the lab.

Risk: API Gateway has no gateway-level JWT authorizer; auth is enforced in-Lambda instead
Mitigation: Write endpoints and the admin route validate the Cognito token + ownership/group in-Lambda (_common.require_owner); public reads stay open for RSVP. Roadmap: add a Cognito JWT authorizer to the HTTP API.

Risk: Weak/known seeded admin password or leaked admin credentials
Mitigation: Force password change on first use; override via SEATME_ADMIN_PASSWORD; keep the admin group small.

Risk: SNS subscription confirmation friction -> invitations not delivered
Mitigation: Clear UI copy explaining the one-time confirm email; report pending vs sent counts; resend support.

Risk: SES blocked in lab -> verification emails land in spam / not delivered
Mitigation: Graceful fallback to Cognito built-in mailer; document spam-folder check; resend-code action.

Risk: Accidental teardown / no backups -> permanent data loss
Mitigation: Confirmation prompts on destructive commands; enable DynamoDB PITR / on-demand backups before teardown.

Risk: Lambda code regression breaks the API during a redeploy
Mitigation: Idempotent deploys; validate with the OpenAPI spec; roadmap: staged alias + automated smoke tests.

Risk: No-login preview link (?host=) lets anyone with the link view an event's details (read-only)
Mitigation: Editing now requires login (writes authorized in-Lambda), so the link is view-only; treat it as a shareable secret. Roadmap: signed, expiring preview tokens instead of raw email.

Risk: Single-region (us-east-1) outage takes the whole app down
Mitigation: Accept for MVP; roadmap: multi-region S3 + DynamoDB global tables + Route 53 failover.

Risk: DynamoDB 400 KB item limit exceeded for very large events
Mitigation: Monitor item size; roadmap: split guests into child items keyed by host+guest for big events.

Risk: XSS via guest-supplied fields (name, song request)
Mitigation: Frontend escapes all user input with escapeHtml() before DOM insertion; server-side validation.

Risk: Placeholder injection fails -> site can't reach API / Cognito
Mitigation: deploy_frontend.py injects config at upload; 'redeploy to re-inject' documented in troubleshooting.

Risk: Cost overrun from traffic spikes or abuse of open endpoints
Mitigation: Pay-per-use scales with usage; roadmap: API throttling/usage plans and AWS Budgets alerts.
